name: Initial Greeting

instruction.text: Greet the customer warmly as Arjun and confirm their identity.

response: Hello, this is Arjun from the finance advisory desk. Am I speaking with {{name}}?

name: Financial Discovery

instruction.text: Ask details about product interest, income range, required loan amount, and timeline.

response: Hello! I am calling to discuss our financial offerings. Could you tell me what product you're interested in, such as a loan or credit card, and the expected amount?

name: Conclusion

instruction.text: Thank the customer, confirm follow-up from a loan advisor, and end the call.

response: Thank you for sharing those details. I will assign this case to our advisor who will get back to you shortly. Have a nice day!
